title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 24: David spares Saul in the cave at En Gedi and Saul admits David is more righteous.

questions.text: How many chosen men did Saul take to seek David?
questions.explanation: Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel and went to seek David.

questions.text: Where did Saul go to seek David and his men?
questions.explanation: Saul went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.

answers.text: The rocks of the wild goats

questions.text: Where were David and his men staying when Saul entered the cave?
questions.explanation: David and his men were staying in the innermost parts of the cave.

answers.text: At the mouth of the cave
In the innermost parts of the cave

questions.text: What did David secretly cut off?
questions.explanation: David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe secretly.

questions.text: How did David feel after cutting off the skirt of Saul's robe?
questions.explanation: Afterward David's heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

answers.text: He felt proud of his deed

questions.text: Why did David refuse to stretch out his hand against Saul?
questions.explanation: David said Yahweh forbid that he should stretch out his hand against Saul, since he is Yahweh's anointed.

answers.text: Saul had once spared David's life

questions.text: To what did David compare himself when speaking to Saul?
questions.explanation: David asked whom the king of Israel was pursuing: "A dead dog? A flea?"

answers.text: A dead dog and a flea
A lost sheep and a lamb
A broken reed and a worm

questions.text: What did Saul do after David finished speaking?
questions.explanation: Saul said, "Is that your voice, my son David?" and lifted up his voice and wept.

answers.text: He threw his spear at David
He lifted up his voice and wept
He turned and left in silence

questions.text: What did Saul say about David's righteousness?
questions.explanation: Saul said to David, "You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you."

answers.text: "You are a rebel against the king"

questions.text: What did Saul ask David to swear?
questions.explanation: Saul asked David to swear by Yahweh that he would not cut off his offspring or destroy his name out of his father's house.

answers.text: Not to cut off Saul's offspring
To leave the land of Israel
To give back the skirt of his robe
